resources.string: If you turn on sharing in Cadence\'s settings, Cadence writes the days you logged a period, and how heavy the flow was, to Health Connect on this phone. Cadence reads menstruation data only when you ask it to copy periods from other apps.
Health Connect keeps data on your phone. Any app you allow in Health Connect can read it, and some apps may upload it, so only allow apps you trust. Cadence itself has no internet access.
Turning sharing off in Cadence removes its access. Data it already shared stays in Health Connect until you delete it there.
